hard_rules: wow-service is the only framework dependency
current tokens are passed unchanged to service and never resolved by the app
exact IDs are parsed mechanically and never looked up by name or path
zero or multiple catalog results are never resolved by the app
exactly one service invocation occurs per valid command
search continuation accepts no selector query profile lane or fresh-budget override
candidate selection requires exact result result-set and candidate IDs and never accepts rank first top best name or sole-candidate shortcuts
search context requires an explicit candidate and strict context request
review input is one explicit strict JSON envelope and plain prose is not a decision
GitHub OS CLI terminal and file ownership never authorize review
no private key access token or credential is accepted in normal CLI/config fixtures
migration validation never applies edits and no migration-apply command exists
impact output preserves static-only path and nonclaim state
envelope JSON equals canonical service bytes plus one LF
artifact mode emits exactly one eligible validated artifact with no wrapper or newline change
text mode preserves Candidate Partial Conflict Truncated NotEvaluated proof and nonclaim state
stdout contains only requested output and stderr contains bounded diagnostics
broken pipe cancellation and output failure never trigger retry or double output
no implicit config cwd home environment editor Git repository WoW client or network discovery
explicit input is bounded data and never executed extracted or scanned recursively
terminal locale clock path and exit code never enter service semantic identity
missing service implementation fixtures platform tests or checksums block implementation
no Cargo Rust source or CI during documentation phase
